test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All planets are rocks.

All rocks are forests.

Conclusions:

(I) At least some rocks are planets.

(II) All planets are forests.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
